adjudication.rationale: In `requestReschedule.handler.ts`, the diff changes `destinationCalendar` to `bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar ? [bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar] : []`, which still provides no fallback to `bookingToReschedule.user.destinationCalendar`. Other handlers in this diff consistently fallback to the user’s destination calendar when the booking’s is missing (e.g. `confirm.handler.ts`, `editLocation.handler.ts`, `deleteCredential.handler.ts`). Given the previous code was effectively `A || A`, this change preserves the omission and now yields an empty array when `bookingToReschedule.destinationCalendar` is null, likely breaking calendar behavior for reschedule requests.
